{{Youmay|a geologic event on [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]|[[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[Joiner]]s''' or '''the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based [[joining ritual]]}}
'''The Joining''' was a period on time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]]. Violent [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] eruptions and [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] racked the planet, resulting in a land bridge forming and connecting the two land masses of the world together. Each land mass had given rise to a sentient [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Meri]]s and the [[Teltior]]s, each unaware of the other.
